verdict: Yes, with a taste edge. Stroom from Ahmedabad pitched a protein bar brand on Shark Tank India Season 5 and got a deal. Protein bars are growing fast, but many established brands compete, so taste, texture and price per gram of protein decide who wins.
angle: Protein bars sell to gym-goers, office workers and travellers. Contract manufacturers can make small runs. Honest labels and lab tests matter, as buyers compare protein and sugar content closely.
